choices.reason: Keep backward reference broad; do not replace it with a claim of common descent or a uniquely identified §1 thesis.
alternatives: now also speaks in favour of this

choices.choice: development; in the languages themselves; them all
choices.reason: Languages is a defensible discourse/context reading of ihnen, not a grammatical proof. Nations remains a possible antecedent. Keep alle pronominal; the explicit earlier choice may tilt the English reader toward languages, a limitation recorded rather than hidden. Nations renders Nationen without an implied modern nation-state.

choices.term: alphabetischer Schrift; eigentlicher Literatur; niedrigeren Stufe
choices.choice: alphabetic writing; literature in the proper sense; a lower level
choices.reason: Preserve both lexical restrictions, the asserted hence relation, without exception and lower comparative. This is Humboldt’s evaluation; no neutral or modern historical correction is silently substituted. The parallel lacks the lower-level phrase.

choices.term: Einerleiheit / Aehnlichkeit; Bau; auch wohl; wirklich
choices.choice: sameness / similarity; structure; also been asserted; in fact
choices.reason: Reject alleged sameness and alleged deviation from all other languages without losing retained similarity. Wrongly modifies only the first assertion. Do not repeat a frequency adverb for the second, where wohl is not clearly temporal. Restore explicit in fact. Structure remains consistent with §1, without fixing a universal glossary.

choices.term: Welttheil; erlaubt; nicht einmal darin; abscheidende Gränzen
choices.choice: continent; do not permit ... even in this respect; genuinely separating boundaries
choices.reason: Retain continent from §1 and idiomatic English plural agreement. The printed singular erlaubt is preserved in the German; it does not by itself establish an intended collective conceptual contrast. Keep darin’s reference open, rather than inserting a claim of a strict north/south genealogy or national border.
alternatives: the continent, north and south, does not permit

audit_dispositions.reason: Keep the defensible explicit languages reading and record the grammatically possible nations antecedent.
Keep them all unexpanded; note that proximity to explicit languages tilts English anaphora without settling German alle.
Retain even in this respect and record the unclear antecedent and focus; no extra geographical or genealogical claim.
Add in fact for wirklich; retain actual similarity versus wrongly asserted sameness.
Remove the second sometimes; retain also been asserted and log wohl as an unresolved modal/discourse nuance.
Keep English plural do. A singular German verb is not sufficient evidence for importing the proposed continent-as-subject recast.
